business_overview.one_sentence: Xinhua Winshare is a PRC publishing and distribution group focused on textbooks, supplementary materials, general books, publication, logistics and related education services.

segments.name: Publication
segments.business_substance: Publishes textbooks, supplementary materials, general books and related publication products.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.business_substance: Distributes textbooks, supplementary materials, general books and education informatization/equipment through offline and online channels.

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue mainly comes from sales and distribution of publications and education-related products and services.
business_notes: The 2025 annual report management discussion states revenue from the publication segment was RMB2,895 million and revenue from the distribution segment was RMB10,212 million.
Working capital indicators show inventory turnover days of 113.6, trade receivables turnover days of 50.7 and trade payables turnover days of 256.5.
